questions.question: When the Ammonites and Moabites hired Balaam to curse the Israelites, what did God do with the curse?

answers.text: He turned it into a blessing
He sent it back onto Moab
He let it fall on Balaam

questions.question: While Nehemiah was away from Jerusalem, what did the priest Eliashib do for his relative Tobiah?

answers.text: Prepared a large room for him
Gave him a seat with the officials

questions.question: When evening shadows fell on Jerusalem just before the Sabbath, what did Nehemiah order to be done?

answers.text: Shut the gates until after the Sabbath
Light a fire beside every gate
Count every load that comes in
